review.public_provider: The current scratch version imports provideZoneChangeDetection only for zoneful mode and passes it through bootstrapModule's applicationProviders option. The Angular core 21.2.23 and 22.1.7 declarations document this exact NgModule usage, mark the function @publicApi, and type applicationProviders as accepting EnvironmentProviders. This avoids placing the environment provider in the NgModule metadata providers array. The declared package peer floors are core ^21.2.23 on 21.x and ^22.1.7 on main, matching the checked declaration versions. The provider choice is applicable to both source lines.
review.mode_assertion: LabRoot injects NgZone and evaluates NgZone.isInAngularZone() inside NgZone.run(). It compares that result to the compile-time mode label and throws before exposing window.__lab or setting document.documentElement.dataset.labReady. A mismatch should therefore prevent the fixture from becoming ready, and waitReady reports bootstrap errors or times out.
review.both_modes: For zoneful mode the source still imports zone.js and supplies provideZoneChangeDetection via applicationProviders. For zoneless it retains the existing provideZonelessChangeDetection provider path and removes the zone.js import. The same assertion expects true in zoneful and false in zoneless.
review.fixture_preservation: The exact diff against each frozen source changes only the generated labSource import/provider selection, injects NgZone into LabRoot, checks mode before readiness, exposes a zoneMode observation, and passes applicationProviders at bootstrap. No component template, action handler, fixture control, consumer DOM, Sass/theme source, or product styling changes appear in either diff.
review.observation_gap: The code exposes __lab.zoneMode but the runner's waitReady checks only the ready dataset and bootstrap error; runCells records cell-specific probe evidence, not this mode observation. The in-page assertion makes an incorrect actual mode fail readiness, but the successful observed mode is not currently persisted with the run receipt. Recommend recording and checking window.__lab.zoneMode in waitReady and attaching it to per-engine/per-mode evidence so the assertion has a durable explicit observation.
review.negative_control_gap: No scratch test deliberately mismatches the expected mode or suppresses the provider and demonstrates a rejected readiness. The assertion is structurally positioned to reject such a mismatch, but that control remains unexecuted. After integration, exercise both actual configurations and a deliberate mismatch that must fail before readiness.
